title: Jackrabbit Alternatives for Dance Studios (2026)
description: Jackrabbit Class alternatives compared on published prices: The Studio Director, Studio Pro, Akada, iClassPro, Studio Helper and Gymdesk.
body:
Jackrabbit Class (marketed to dance studios as Jackrabbit Dance) starts at $49/mo, but the price rises with your total student count at the end of each month and the pricing page doesn't publish the tiers above $49. A custom-branded parent app (Jackrabbit Plus) starts at $93/mo plus a one-time, non-refundable $169 setup fee and app store fees, and Enterprise is $245/mo ($331/mo with the app). Jackrabbit lists no contracts or setup fees on the core plan, free data imports and unlimited support (Jackrabbit pricing, checked 2026-11-10). If you want a price you can see before a demo, flat pricing with unlimited students, or a different feature mix, here is what the main alternatives publish.

We checked each vendor's own public pricing page on November 10, 2026 (Dance Business Solutions on November 7, 2026) and list only what they publish. Anything not published is marked unknown. We haven't used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:jackrabbit-class,studio-director,studio-pro,akada,iclasspro,studio-helper}}

The alternatives

  • The Studio Director: the only dance-focused tool here that publishes its full student-count table. 0-100 students is $65/mo software only or $39/mo with its payment processing; 101-250 is $119 or $79; 251-500 is $169 or $119; 501-1000 is $199 or $149; 1001-5000 runs $209-$329 ($199-$319 with payments). Month to month, no setup fee, 30-day money-back guarantee instead of a free trial. Lists a parent portal, recitals with ticket sales and costume size charts. {{aff:studiodirector|Visit The Studio Director}}
  • Studio Pro (formerly DanceStudio-Pro): flat plans with unlimited students: Essentials $49/mo, Premier $79/mo, Elite $165/mo. Recital planning, costume management, ticket sales and a parent portal app are on Essentials. Free student import, 30-day free trial with no card. Built-in Stripe processing from 2.66% + $0.25 (U.S.); other processors add a 1.35% tech fee. {{aff:studiopro|Visit Studio Pro}}
  • Akada Software: one flat $60/mo with every feature and no tiers. Lists online registration with approvals, tuition billing, staff time tracking, recital scheduling with costume sizing and billing, 200+ reports and free texting. Trial and contract terms aren't published. {{aff:akada|Visit Akada}}
  • iClassPro: the closest match if, like many Jackrabbit customers, you run gymnastics, cheer or swim as well as dance. Signature $139/mo and Elite $199/mo per location with no commitment; Premium $299/mo per location on a 12-month commitment. Priced per location, not per student. Lists skill tracking, check-in kiosk, online waivers, make-up tokens and party booking. A branded app is $499 setup + $150/mo; outbound texts are $0.03 per credit in the U.S. and Canada. {{aff:iclasspro|Visit iClassPro}}
  • Studio Helper: $50/mo plus $0.25 per student, one plan with all features, aimed at teaching studios (music, dance and others) with several teachers. By our arithmetic that is $70/mo at 80 students and $100/mo at 200. Lists payroll and expense tracking. {{aff:studio-helper|Visit Studio Helper}}
  • Gymdesk: a general gym and studio platform priced by active members: $75, $100 or $150/mo with Gymdesk Payments for up to 50, 100 or 150 members ($100-$175 with your own processor); 151-250 members is $240/mo, or $40 less with Gymdesk Payments. Month to month, 30-day trial with no card, website included. It doesn't list recital or costume tools. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}
  • Dance Business Solutions: a UK-based dance studio marketing and operations package at £90/month (checked 2026-11-07), focused on enquiry-to-enrolment automation and websites. {{aff:dancebusinesssolutions|Visit Dance Business Solutions}}

Subscription only, one location. Payment processing, texting and app add-ons are extra where they apply. Studio Helper figures are our arithmetic from its published rate. Gymdesk counts active members rather than students, so it's left out of this table.

Which alternative fits which studio

  • You want a published price before booking a demo: The Studio Director, Studio Pro, Akada and iClassPro all publish their prices; Jackrabbit publishes only its starting price.
  • You're growing past 100-200 students: Studio Pro (from $49/mo) and Akada ($60/mo) don't charge more as enrollment grows. The Studio Director and Jackrabbit are tiered by student count.
  • You want a branded parent app: Jackrabbit Plus starts at $93/mo + $169 setup; iClassPro's branded app is $499 setup + $150/mo. Studio Pro includes its own Parent Portal app on every plan and Akada lists the Akada Portal family app (neither is described as custom-branded).
  • You run gymnastics, cheer or swim too: iClassPro and The Studio Director both market to gymnastics; Jackrabbit and iClassPro also list swim and cheer.

Before you switch

Jackrabbit says you can lower your bill by archiving inactive families, since pricing is based on total student count at month end, so check that first if cost is the only reason to leave. If you do move, ask the new vendor how it imports families, enrollments and stored payment methods: Studio Pro says it imports your students from a spreadsheet at no charge, and Jackrabbit lists free data imports for customers moving in. Ask both vendors whether stored cards can be transferred between processors or whether families will need to re-enter them, before you announce a change. Our software buying checklist covers what to ask on a demo.

faq: Jackrabbit Class starts at $49/mo and is tiered by total student count at the end of each month; higher tiers aren't published. Jackrabbit Plus (with a branded app) starts at $93/mo plus a $169 one-time setup fee and app store fees, and Enterprise is $245/mo or $331/mo with the app (Jackrabbit pricing page, checked 2026-11-10).
What is the cheapest Jackrabbit alternative for a small dance studio?

Among the tools we list, The Studio Director is $39/mo for 0-100 students if you use its payment processing ($65/mo without). Studio Pro Essentials is $49/mo with unlimited students and Akada is $60/mo flat (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-11-10).
Which Jackrabbit alternatives include recital and costume tools?

Studio Pro lists recital planning, costume management and ticket sales on its $49/mo Essentials plan; Akada lists recital scheduling with costume sizing and billing; The Studio Director lists recitals with ticket sales and costume size charts (vendor pages).
Is there a Jackrabbit alternative for gymnastics and swim schools?

iClassPro says its plans suit gymnastics, cheer, swim and dance schools, from $139/mo per location (Signature) to $299/mo per location (Premium, 12-month commitment). The Studio Director also markets to gymnastics businesses (vendor pages).
Do Jackrabbit alternatives offer free trials?

Studio Pro offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card (lead management and payment processing are off during the trial). The Studio Director offers a 30-day money-back guarantee instead. Jackrabbit, Akada and iClassPro don't publish a free trial on the pages we checked.
